judge-football.justification: Usable (7.9): three-line decision rule applied to a full 2025 board and all 109 runners; asks for 3-4 hoop runs in the drill protocol; named cases (Ezeiruaku, Phillips, Downs, Burch, Murphy); pick-slot translation (0.8 pressures ~ pick 100 to 76). Explicitly a tiebreaker. Effect under one pressure a season, interval touches zero under the stricter baseline, gain flat on the 49 players who ran the 40. Confounders (8.5): baseline of log pick, weight, NGS score, EDGE share; 100+ rush availability cut (games played 1.0 vs 14.0); 40-skipper interaction; EDGE vs interior and alignment splits; single-run reliability 0.41; year-standardization; 14-pair multiplicity correction; placebo outcomes. Blocker type, scheme, stunts acknowledged as missing. Unique (7.5): same formula applied to Combine and NFL snaps; honest null on drill bend to rush-path bend (0.10); sideways-g tied to dip and rip is novel framing; still a regression of production on a Combine metric, effect is a lead (best-of-14 p=0.121). Terminology (7.8): mostly right (EDGE/interior, wide-9, dip and rip, sacks per pressure); 'equals moving from pick 100 to 76' is loose; bend as sideways g at 1.8-yd hoop radius is a stretch from true edge bend.
top_changes: Add a stronger football validation, e.g. film-grounded checks of high-bend rushers' win type (dip, rip, ghost) on sampled snaps. Show hoop run, trace and NFL snap for 3-4 named players at once, including Ezeiruaku and Phillips, so bend is anchored in technique. Bend is unrelated to game bend (0.10), which undercuts the label.

Publish the board inline as a compact table: name, pick, weight, EDGE/interior, shrunk bend with interval, pressure vs forecast, call. Top 8 and bottom 4 of 2025 plus the 10 plus and 8 minus across 2023-25.

Resolve the headline tension and trim statistical load. Pick one planning number (0.8 pressures a season), state it once, with the plain sentence that the gain vanishes among players with a 40. Move the 36% bootstrap and mixed-model details to the appendix. Flag pressure by blocker or alignment as a limitation instead of 'our read: general change-of-direction trait'.

judge-datascience.justification: Full re-run of analysis.py did not finish in 9 min, so not all numbers verified by re-execution; board-level numbers reproduced from board_2023_2025.csv with no contradictions. Pipeline: no-tracking baseline (log pick, weight, NGS, EDGE share) plus imputed 10-yd/3-cone variant, class-stratified leave-one-class-out with bootstrap CIs, best-of-14 permutation and nested re-selection, empirical-Bayes shrinkage, reliability (0.41, Spearman-Brown to 3-4 runs), has-40 interaction (p=0.74), placebo outcomes, survivorship check. Text generated from template filled with numbers.json, fixing earlier 0.18/0.19 and 0.57/0.61 inconsistencies. Honest framing: held-out gain CI spans zero, gain vanishes on the 49 players with a 40, shrunk effect (0.8 pressures a season) is the headline. Innovation: sideways-g metric computed identically from Combine and NFL 10 Hz tracks, drill-to-play link (null, 0.10), coach-readable decision rule with a board. Weaknesses: n=63, lead fails p<0.05 after correction; held-out gain positive in only 75% of bootstraps; 36% on the 49-player subset undercuts the tiebreaker recommendation; numbers.json has near-duplicate keys (dr2_lo -0.155 vs v_dr2lo_main -0.161); whole-pipeline leave-one-class-out shown only as 3 folds of about 21 players.
top_changes: Rerun the fully nested leave-one-class-out (selection among 14 pairs, imputation and shrinkage refit inside each fold); report per-class and pooled delta R2 with a bootstrap over players as the one primary out-of-class estimate. Drop the competing 'in-sample real link' wording.

Replace one-sided bootstrap-share summaries with a Bayesian partial-pooling model (class random intercept, EDGE/interior slope, measurement-error-corrected bend using 0.41 reliability). Report a posterior for pressures per season and P(effect>0.5) as the single headline.

Close the selection and opportunity gap: exposure-weighted (binomial/beta-binomial) pressure model on all 109 runners with games played as offset. Add a second placebo outcome (run-stop rate) and a negative-control drill (backpedal). Deduplicate and canonicalize numbers.json keys.

judge-writeup.justification: check.py passes: 1,754 words, 6 figures, 2 tables. Structure close to finalist pattern: hedged-finding title, result with draft-slot translation, Hoop G definition early, why DL why now, concrete decision rule. Problems: (1) opening ~75 words with jargon ('14 drill-and-outcome pairs we screened', 'standard deviation of bend'); (2) Finding 2 and 'Does it matter' carry p-values, bootstrap shares, interaction CIs and 3.1 raw vs 0.8 shrunk in prose, duplicated in appendix; (3) pre-registered subgroup stated as one the authors expect to fail, contradicting the closing claim that bend matters most for the no-40 group; (4) 'Does it matter to a GM?' is dense and slightly contradictory. Smaller: 'It is a lead' used loosely; Technique section mostly nulls; four-item baseline described inconsistently.
top_changes: Rewrite the opening to ~55 plain words, e.g. 'Plan on under one extra pressure a season for a rusher one notch better at bend. That is a tiebreaker, not a reason to move up a round.' Move screening explanation to Finding 2.

Cut Finding 2 and 'Does it matter to a GM?' to the table plus ~100 words. Move the 36% bootstrap share, interaction CI, 'best of 14' and 'one time in eight' to the appendix. One headline number (0.8), 3.1 only in the table. Interaction in two sentences.

Fix subgroup and no-40 logic: delete or reframe 'The no-40 group is where it matters most in practice'; reword the pre-registered subgroup or state it as a null check. Cut or merge the Technique section into two sentences plus a table row, and drop one figure (Fig 4 or Fig 5).

judge-viz.justification: Tracking-native visuals: Fig 1 puts drill and game paths side by side, coloured by the metric, with a forecast-vs-actual dumbbell and rule-based player selection. Colorblind-safe palettes. Uncertainty shown everywhere (CIs, bootstrap bands, violins, power bands), n stated, titles carry the takeaway. Weak points: economy and legibility. 6 figures plus 3 tables within limit, but Fig 1 and Fig 5 repeat the same card idea; Fig 6 is a tall 42-row chart with an overprinted x-axis label; Fig 2 and Fig 4 are correlation-style forests; small path-card header text near 8 pt at column width.
top_changes: Fig 6 (2025 board): fix colliding x-axis labels ("shrunk bend, sd (bar = 80% interval)" overprints "2025 pressure rate"). Cut to ~12 informative rows (plus, minus, film-first, plus the 5 with rookie samples above 200 rushes) and move the full 42 to a table or appendix. 2250 px tall so text shrinks. Label neutral rows by grey only; add legend entry for the pink film-first colour.

Fig 1 plus Fig 5 overlap (both drill-vs-game path cards, Ezeiruaku in each). Fold Phillips into Fig 1 or into one 8-card small multiple and drop Fig 5. In Fig 1 the dumbbell panel and card captions state the same numbers. Enlarge 'NFL (20 rushes)' header text. Make the red ring and orange pressure dots differ. Add a yards axis label to path squares.

Fig 2 and Fig 4 are forests of rho and R2 gain. Merge Fig 4 left panel (baseline robustness) into Fig 3 caption or table, keep only the Fig 4 right panel (forecast gain violins). Violin tails clipped at +/-0.6 in the '+10-yd and 3-cone' row: say so or widen. In Fig 2 add a one-line direct label for diamonds and check n values (27, 54, 68, 63) match the text. In Fig 3 use a facet per group, and tie the C. Johnson label to the text.
